Home
Treasurer Office
Contact
Kathy Peppel
Treasurer
402-775-2581
treasurer@boydcounty.ne.gov
Office Hours
8:15 a.m. – 4:00 p.m.
Monday – Friday
Open through the lunch hour
Closed Weekends and Holidays
Mailing Address
PO Box 25
Butte, NE 68722
Location
401 Thayer Street
Butte, NE 68722
Treasurer Office
Duties
To collect all revenues for the County
To bill and collect all real estate and personal taxes in the County
Register all motor vehicles and boats with tax situs in the County
To issue driver licenses, C.D.L.’s, learner permits, I.D. cards, school permits, provisional operator permits, etc
To disburse collections to the proper political subdivisions
Boat Registration
Snowmobile Registration
DMV Services is a Department of the State of Nebraska that is operated by the Treasurer Office.
